request.text: Grandma is right in front of you showing you our old family album. Please look at Grandma for four seconds while she points out the wedding photo.

responsibilities.outcome: Direct the robot's gaze toward Grandma for four seconds while she shows the wedding photo.

semantic_facts: The plan should use the person-gaze Capability to preserve Grandma as the intended person and four seconds as the requested duration.
Planning the gaze must not be treated as proof that Runtime has identified Grandma or that the movement has occurred.
forbidden_claims: The Planner claims to see or have already looked at Grandma without trusted perception or execution evidence.
The plan replaces the requested gaze with blinking, walking, or another physical action.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A user-supplied person description is converted into fabricated live-perception evidence or an invented opaque target identity.
A nearby facial or locomotion Capability is substituted for the requested sustained gaze.
